Index: todolist.md
===================================================================
--- todolist.md	
+++ todolist.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,231 @@
+# Rx Compiler Todolist — 阶段一：AST（至第 4 周周日 23:59 验收）
+
+> 依据：`starting_letter.txt`、`README-EN.md`、[Rx 语言规范](https://acmclasscourse-2025.github.io/rx-compiler-specification/)、官方测试集 `tests/official`（45 个 semantic suite、约 236 个 `.rx`）
+> 语言：Modern C++（C++17+），前端用现成 ANTLR g4 文法生成 C++ lexer/parser
+> 本阶段验收 = **ANTLR 前端 + AST 构建 + 名称解析/类型检查**，`config.mk` 的 `SEMANTIC` 能跑通 `official:semantic` 正/负用例；Code Review 通过（失败 = 本阶段未完成）
+
+---
+
+## 0. 验收契约（先对齐，再动手）
+
+- [ ] 确认退出码契约：接受程序 `exit 0`；正常拒绝 `exit 1`；崩溃 / 信号 / 超时 / 其他退出码一律判负例失败（测试脚本 `scripts/test.py:307`）
+- [ ] 语法错误必须让整个编译失败（文法注释明确要求：解析器不得报错后继续建树编译），lexer 的 `ERROR_CHAR`、`UNTERMINATED_BLOCK_COMMENT`、`INVALID_NUMBER`、`INVALID_LIFETIME`、`INVALID_CHARACTER_LITERAL`、`RESERVED_KEYWORD` 等 token 都不能被静默接受
+- [ ] 验收形式与 TA 确认（现场 demo？只看 `make test` 结果？AST 是否需要可打印/可复查）
+- [ ] 遵守 AI 规范：不允许整段 AI 生成；核心设计、代码自己能讲清楚（Code Review 会问）
+- [ ] 本阶段不实现：借用/生命周期检查、所有权检查、常量表达式求值以外的优化（规范保证 lifetime 有效；move/copy 语义留到 IR/CodeGen）
+
+## 1. 环境与仓库准备（Day 1–2）
+
+### 1.1 先修 CRLF（重要，否则 git diff 全脏）
+
+当前工作区所有文件被 Git for Windows checkout 成了 CRLF，`git status` 显示 17 个文件全被"修改"（实际只是换行符）。提交前必须处理：
+
+```sh
+git config core.autocrlf input
+git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --stat   # 确认真实改动为空
+git checkout -- .                    # 将工作区恢复为 LF
+```
+
+- [ ] 执行上面的修复
+- [ ] 建议加 `.gitattributes`：`* text=auto eol=lf`，一劳永逸
+- [ ] 可选：编译器工程放 WSL 原生文件系统（如 `~/rx-compiler`）再软链/拷回，`/mnt/c` 上 CMake 并行构建与测试会慢很多
+
+### 1.2 初始化子模块
+
+```sh
+git submodule update --init --recursive   # tests/official、vendor/REIMU、spec
+```
+
+- [ ] 初始化后先通读 `tests/official/semantic/**/manifest.json` 和对应 `.rx`，把每个 suite 的需求整理成自己的对照表（这是最权威的需求清单）
+
+### 1.3 ANTLR 工具与 C++ runtime（本阶段核心依赖）
+
+工具已就绪：`/usr/local/lib/antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar`（已实测能对现有 4.13.2 文法生成 C++ 代码，无报错）。runtime 需自行编译（apt 的 `libantlr4-runtime-dev` 只有 4.10，版本不匹配，不要用）：
+
+```sh
+git clone --branch 4.13.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/antlr/antlr4.git /tmp/antlr4
+cmake -S /tmp/antlr4/runtime/Cpp -B /tmp/antlr4/runtime/Cpp/build \
+  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DANTLR_BUILD_CPP_TESTS=OFF -DWITH_DEMO=OFF \
+  -DANTLR_BUILD_STATIC=ON -DANTLR_BUILD_SHARED=OFF \
+  -DANTLR4_INSTALL=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$HOME/antlr4-4.13.1"
+cmake --build /tmp/antlr4/runtime/Cpp/build -j"$(nproc)"
+cmake --install /tmp/antlr4/runtime/Cpp/build
+```
+
+- [ ] 编译并安装 runtime（工具/运行时同为 4.13.1，匹配）
+- [ ] 生成代码（两段式，先 Lexer 再 Parser，`tokenVocab` 才能找到）：
+
+```sh
+GEN=compiler/generated
+mkdir -p $GEN
+java -jar /usr/local/lib/antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar -Dlanguage=Cpp -o $GEN grammar/Lexer.g4
+java -jar /usr/local/lib/antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar -Dlanguage=Cpp -visitor \
+  -o $GEN -lib $GEN grammar/Parser.g4
+```
+
+- [ ] 写进 CMake `add_custom_command`（源文件变更才重新生成），生成物不入库
+
+### 1.4 后续阶段才需要的（本阶段可不装，但别踩坑）
+
+- REIMU 需要 `xmake`（当前未装）；Clang 22 仅 IR 测试需要；`rustup target add riscv32im-unknown-none-elf` 仅参考 rustc 需要
+- [ ] （可选）W1 顺手装好，避免 IR 阶段再折腾
+- [ ] 开发期关闭 CI：`mv .github/workflows/test.yml .github/workflows/test.yml.disabled`（README 建议）
+
+## 2. 工程骨架与 CLI 契约
+
+建议结构（可自行微调，重点是职责分离）：
+
+```
+compiler/
+├── CMakeLists.txt          # C++17；find_package(antlr4-runtime 4.13.1)；链接 antlr4_static
+├── generated/              # ANTLR 生成物（gitignore）
+└── src/
+    ├── main.cpp            # CLI 入口
+    ├── common/             # SourceLoc、Diagnostic、错误类型
+    ├── frontend/           # ParseTree → AST（visitor）、语法错误监听
+    ├── ast/                # AST 节点定义
+    └── sema/               # 符号表、类型、推断/强制转换、const 求值、检查器
+```
+
+- [ ] CLI：`rxcc --stage semantic {source}`（后续再加 `--stage ir/codegen -o`），语义阶段不需要 `-o`
+- [ ] 所有诊断写 stderr，带 `file:line:col`；任何编译错误统一 `exit 1`
+- [ ] 用自定义 `ANTLRInputStream`/`BailErrorStrategy` 或错误计数：lexer/parser 报错即终止，绝不带着错误恢复的 parse tree 继续
+- [ ] `config.mk` 改成本项目命令，例如：
+
+```make
+BUILD = cmake -S compiler -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
+    -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$(HOME)/antlr4-4.13.1 && cmake --build build -j && : > {runtime}
+SEMANTIC = ./build/rxcc --stage semantic {source}
+```
+
+- [ ] 自测：`make test FILTER=official:semantic STAGE=semantic VERBOSE=true`（BUILD 只跑一次，增量构建即可；单例编译超时默认 30s，必要时 `COMPILE_TIMEOUT=60`）
+
+## 3. 前端：parse tree → AST
+
+- [ ] 先做一个隐藏调试子命令（如 `--dump-ast`）打印 AST/parse tree，用于快速定位问题（不影响验收命令行为）
+- [ ] AST 节点清单（Rx 子集）：
+  - Items：`Use`（解析后丢弃）、`Fn`（名、参数、返回类型、block）、`Struct`（字段、derive 属性）、`Const`、`Impl`（关联 fn/const）
+  - Types：`Path`（`i32/u32/isize/usize/bool/Box<T>/Vec<T>/Self/结构体`）、`Ref`（`&/&mut`）、`Array [T; N]`、`Unit ()`
+  - Stmts：`Let`（含 `mut`、可选类型标注）、表达式语句、块尾表达式
+  - Exprs：`Literal(i32/u32/isize/usize/bool)`、`Path`、`Block`、`If`、`Loop`、`While`、`Break`、`Continue`、`Return`、`Unary`、`Binary`、`Assign/CompoundAssign`、`Call`、`MethodCall`、`Field`、`Index`、`Array`（列表 / `[expr; N]`）、`StructExpr`、`Grouped`、`Cast`、`Ref`、`Deref`
+  - 全部节点带源码位置（语义错误要能报行列）
+- [ ] 语法糖在 AST 层规范化（例如：`if` 两分支/loop break 值的"块尾表达式"统一表示，`-2147483648i32` 按规范处理符号最小值），但**不要**在 AST 层做任何类型推断
+- [ ] 丢弃 `use` 与一切 lifetime 语法（参数、`&'a T`、`where 'a: 'b`、`Type::<'a>` 实参），保留引用类型与 `mut` 限定
+- [ ] 在 `tests/custom` 写正/负语法自测（解析成功/失败），并覆盖 `>>`/`>=`/`>>=`/`&&` 上下文歧义与 `{ make() }.field` 这类语句边界
+- [ ] 不要修改 `grammar/*.g4`
+
+## 4. 语义分析（本阶段 80% 工作量）
+
+> 先以官方 45 个 semantic suite 为准逐条实现；下列为规范关键规则清单。
+
+### 4.1 名称解析与作用域（spec: names）
+
+- [ ] 两个独立命名空间：类型名（结构体、基元、`Box/Vec/Self`）与值名（fn、const、局部、`self`）；`Type::member` 前缀查类型空间；字段在结构体字段空间
+- [ ] 顶层项与关联项查找与声明顺序无关；局部绑定自初始化器之后可见到块尾、可遮蔽（最近绑定优先，被遮蔽的不可回退）
+- [ ] 结构体全部固有 `impl` 共享一个关联值空间；重复方法/关联函数/关联常量（含跨 impl、不论签名）= 编译错误；字段与固有方法可同名
+- [ ] 保护名：类型空间 `i32/u32/isize/usize/bool/Box/Vec/Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq`；值空间 `get_i32/print_i32/println_i32`。其他名空间里同名合法（字段、关联项）；固有 impl 只能给用户结构体
+- [ ] `let`/参数与可见非限定常量同名、结构体名用保护名、局部名用保护 I/O 名 = UB（测试不会出现，可不专门诊断）
+- [ ] `main` 的检查：`fn main() -> ()`（可省略返回标注、空参数、无泛型），以 `semantic/entry`、`source-main-calls` 用例为准
+
+### 4.2 类型系统与推断（spec: types）
+
+- [ ] 类型表示：四种整数 `i32/isize/u32/usize` 互不相同、`bool`、具名结构体、`[T; N]`、`&/&mut T`、`()`、`Box<T>`、`Vec<T>`；never（发散）
+- [ ] 整数类型确定：①后缀；②无后缀取 expected type（仅四种整数之一）；③否则 `i32`。选定后不改；字面量大小不参与类型选择；超范围 = UB
+- [ ] expected-type 位点：带标注 `let` / const 初始化器（有声明类型时）/ 赋值右值 / 调用实参 / 函数尾与 `return` / 结构体字段初始化器；传播穿过括号、块尾、`if` 两分支、同一 loop 的所有 break 值；不穿透二元/一元/借用
+- [ ] LUB：`if-else` 两分支、数组元素、同一 loop 的 break 值；按源码序调整（只从 `T` 到能接受的 `U`），无公共目标 = UB；忽略 never；裸 `break;` 给 `()`
+- [ ] 强制转换（coercion）：`&mut T → &T`、`.field`/`*` 内建解引用路径上的 `&S/&mut S → &T`、never → 任意；不做隐式借用、不转换容器元素、不产生 slice
+- [ ] `as` 仅 int↔int、bool→int；保留 32 位模式；cast 目标不给操作数 expected（`1 as u32` 中 `1` 是 i32）
+- [ ] 递归布局：按值包含环（结构体/内联数组）无有限大小 = 编译错误；`Box/Vec/&` 提供间接层，允许递归/互递归
+- [ ] never 类型与不可达代码：不可达代码里的普通名称/类型/mutability 错误仍是编译错误（place mutability 违规是 UB），`if` 无 else 结果须 `()`，loop 体须 `()`
+
+### 4.3 place 与可变性（spec: expressions/operator-expr、references）
+
+- [ ] 赋值目标必须是可变 place（`mut` 局部、`&mut` 解引用、可变字段链、Vec 可变索引等）；`&mut place` 需要可变 place
+- [ ] 访问路径一旦穿过共享引用，后续不能恢复可变访问；Vec 索引的隐式借用规则（读共享、写/可变借用需要该索引步骤可变访问）按规范实现
+- [ ] `*` 只对 `&/&mut` 和 `Box` 解引用（Vec 不可解引用）；读 Copy 复制、读非 Copy 从 owned Box 移动等是语义（IR/CodeGen 再做），本阶段类型/mutability 判对即可
+
+### 4.4 表达式与运算符（spec: expressions/*）
+
+- [ ] 算术/位运算：两操作数各为 `T` 或 `&T`，同一整数 T（位运算还支持 bool）；一元 `-` 有符号整数；`!` 整数或 bool；移位左右可不同整数，结果为左类型
+- [ ] 比较：`==/!=` 要求同一源类型且实现 PartialEq（不做隐式 coercion，不从对侧推断字面量）；`< <= > >=` 仅整数/bool、各层可变性匹配且终为标量，允许 `&T` 与 `&mut T` 混合（调整）
+- [ ] `&&/||` 仅 bool、短路、无整数真值
+- [ ] 复合赋值：目标可变 place 的基元类型与右侧匹配；不从目标推断右侧（`n: u32; n += 1` 是 UB）
+- [ ] `[elem; N]`：elem 只求值一次；`N > 1` 时 elem 须 Copy；长度是常量上下文；数组 `.len()` 是 `&self` 方法
+- [ ] 求值顺序：普通二元先左后右；赋值先右值→目标地址→存；复合赋值先右操作数→目标地址→读/更新（官方测试不查复合赋值两个操作数相对顺序）
+
+### 4.5 方法查找、容器与内建 I/O（spec: expressions/method-call-expr、heap、undefined-behavior/builtin）
+
+- [ ] 方法查找算法：接收者类型、对 `&/&mut/Box` 解引用后每个类型插 `&T`/`&mut T`；多个不同匹配 = UB；无匹配 = 编译错误；选中后再查 mut 与实参
+- [ ] `Box<T>`：`Box::<T>::new(value)`；`Vec<T>`：`Vec::<T>::new()`、`len(&self)`、`is_empty(&self)`、`push(&mut self, T)`、`remove(&mut self, usize) -> T`
+- [ ] 容器构造必须显式具体类型实参（`Box::new(7)`/`Vec::new()` 是 UB）
+- [ ] `get_i32() -> i32`、`print_i32(i32) -> ()`、`println_i32(i32) -> ()`；其他整数类型实参必须显式 cast
+- [ ] 字段访问、结构体构造（`S { x: 1 }`、`Self { ... }`）、索引 `place[index]`、`place = value` 的类型规则
+
+### 4.6 常量求值（spec: const_eval）
+
+- [ ] 常量上下文仅三处：const 项初始化器、数组类型长度、`[elem; N]` 的长度
+- [ ] `const` 值只能是 `ConstValue` 语法（字面量/常量路径/负号/括号）；常量路径可指向顶层常量或关联常量（`Self::LIMIT`），指向局部/函数 = 编译错误
+- [ ] 依赖图无环检测（自引用/循环 = 编译错误，在求值前检测）；声明顺序无关
+- [ ] 求值结果与声明类型/`usize` expected type 对齐，有符号最值按规范处理
+
+### 4.7 derive 与内建 trait（spec: traits-and-attributes、builtin-traits）
+
+- [ ] 只识别 `Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq`，`#[derive(...)]` 语法解析后做"能力"递归校验：
+  - `Copy`：每字段 Copy，且同一结构体必须显式 derive `Clone`
+  - `Clone`：每字段 Clone（`&mut T` 不是 Clone）
+  - `PartialEq`：每字段 PartialEq
+  - `Eq`：每字段 Eq 且 PartialEq 已显式 derive
+- [ ] 标量/引用/数组/`Box`/`Vec` 的能力表按规范；递归类型（如 `Node { children: Vec<Node> }`）校验要能终止
+- [ ] `#[derive]` 之外没有内建方法：只有 `.clone()`、`==`、`!=` 三个入口
+
+### 4.8 明确不实现（规范保证不会考）
+
+- 生命周期有效性、借用检查、所有权有效性证明、整数溢出检查、越界检查/panic、文档注释
+- 常量传播等优化（可选，放到 Optimize 阶段）
+
+## 5. 测试策略与覆盖矩阵
+
+常用命令：
+
+```sh
+make test FILTER=official:semantic STAGE=semantic VERBOSE=true
+make test FILTER=official:semantic:names-and-shadowing VERBOSE=true
+make test FILTER=custom
+```
+
+- 失败日志在 `target/tests/run-*/`（含 `.command/.stdout/.stderr`），逐条对照
+- [ ] 逐 suite 点亮 45 个 semantic suite（建议顺序）：
+  1. 基础：`casts-and-literals`、`integer-arithmetic`、`shifts`、`compound-assignment`、`boolean-and-short-circuit`
+  2. 名称：`names-and-shadowing`、`namespace-errors`、`protected-names`、`lifetimes-and-use`
+  3. 类型：`expected-types`、`runtime-value-merges`、`loop-state-merges`、`blocks-if-and-never`、`unreachable-checks`
+  4. 引用：`references-and-mutability`、`reference-coercions`、`reference-lub`、`scalar-reference-operators`、`vec-index-mutability`
+  5. 聚合：`arrays`、`structs-and-fields`、`nested-containers`、`recursive-layout`、`aggregate-arguments-and-reference-fields`
+  6. 函数：`calls-recursion-and-abi`、`methods-and-self`、`evaluation-order-and-temporaries`、`live-state-calls`、`loops-and-jumps`
+  7. 容器/trait：`box-and-moves`、`vec-operations`、`copy-clone-and-equality`、`trait-dispatch-and-reference-equality`
+  8. 常量：`constants-and-paths`、`constant-errors`
+  9. impl：`invalid-impls-and-generics`、`recursive-traits`
+  10. 入口：`entry`、`builtin-io`、`source-main-calls`
+  11. 综合：5 个 `comprehensive-*`
+- [ ] 负例专项：确保是"正常 exit 1"而不是崩溃/超时；对每条错误给出可读诊断
+- [ ] `tests/custom` 补充边角：`>>`/`>>=` 歧义、`&&x`、cast 后 `<`、块尾/语句边界、嵌套 `Vec<Box<T>>`
+
+## 6. 四周排期（滚动推进，W4 留 buffer）
+
+- **W1**：环境（CRLF、子模块、ANTLR runtime/生成、CMake、CLI、config.mk）+ parse tree → AST 全量节点 + `--dump-ast`；目标：随机 semantic 正例不崩溃
+- **W2**：符号表/名称解析/作用域/命名空间 + 基础类型检查（带标注、字面量、运算符、赋值/place）；点亮第 1–3 组 suite
+- **W3**：expected type/LUB/coercion + 方法查找 + `Box/Vec` + 内建 I/O + const 求值 + derive 能力 + 递归布局；点亮第 4–9 组
+- **W4**：入口/常量/综合 suite、负例专项、性能（大文件 <30s）、代码整理与注释、自测 `--dump-ast` 复核、Code Review 预演（能讲清 AST 结构与类型检查算法）；**W4 周日 23:59 前全绿**
+
+## 7. 课程事务清单（贯穿本阶段）
+
+- [ ] **每周邮件答疑记录**：强制提交（即使本周无内容也要发邮件说明"本周无记录"）；有提问就整理清楚
+- [ ] **Code Review**：一学期至少 4 次（2–3 次常规 + 1–2 次抽查）；本阶段要准备好讲 AST 设计、名称解析、类型推断、错误处理，避免"整段 AI 生成"的观感
+- [ ] **第 4 周考试**：编译器设计内容，自行完成即可及格；考试表现会影响 Code Review 次数/时长，复习重点：词法/语法/类型系统/推断
+- [ ] 线下答疑（预计每周四晚）、线上邮件答疑按通知参加
+- [ ] AI 使用规范：只做辅助，逐段理解、逐段手写；核心代码保留自己的设计痕迹
+

1: # Rx Compiler Template
2: 
3: [![Tests](https://github.com/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler/actions/workflows/test.yml)

7: 
8: > Replace this with your own README when you start working on your compiler.
9: 
10: ## Getting Started
11: 
12: Welcome to the Rx Compiler course! This repository provides a template from which you can build your own compiler for [the Rx programming language](https://acmclasscourse-2025.github.io/rx-compiler-specification/). It includes official testcases, a test scaffold, and the G4 representation of Rx to get you started.
13: 
14: We strongly recommend that you **fork this repository** instead of downloading zips, in case we need to update the official testcases. After forking your copy, clone it to your local machine.
15: 
16: Initialize the testcases and [REIMU](https://github.com/wanoful/REIMU) submodules:
17: 
18: ```sh
19: git submodule update --init --recursive
20: ```
21: 
22: Python 3, [xmake](https://xmake.io/) and any C++23 compiler is needed to build REIMU. Build REIMU separately from the project root before running tests:
23: 
24: ```sh
25: xmake f -y -P vendor/REIMU -m release -o target/reimu
26: xmake -y -P vendor/REIMU
27: ```
28: 
29: Rerun these commands after updating the REIMU submodule.
30: 
31: If you want to run default `rustc` test, install `rustup`, and run
32: ```sh
33: rustup target add riscv32im-unknown-none-elf
34: ```
35: 
36: IR tests also require **Clang 22**.
37: 
38: ## Overview
39: 
40: In this course you can use **any language** to implement your compiler. Contact the TA if your language is not mainstream so that we can provide support for it on the Online Judge. For this reason, the template we provide here is **language-agnostic**. You will find:
41: 
42: - Testcases under `tests/`. Official testcases reside under `tests/official` and is a git submodule. You may add your own testcases under `tests/custom`.
43: - A test runner. The `Makefile` runs testcases using the compiler configured in `config.mk`. By default it uses your system rustc with the `riscv32im-unknown-none-elf` target and executes generated assembly in REIMU. **Replace the compiler commands in `config.mk` with your own compiler commands** to set up testing for your compiler. See [Running tests](#running-tests) for details.
44:     - Some auxiliary files (such as the reference compiler helper code in `crates/rx`) help the default rustc produce assembly suitable for REIMU. Its `src/entry.rs` is compiled separately for each testcase and supplies the bare-metal entry point and `Box`/`Vec` imports. The library implements integer I/O through REIMU's libc, plus allocation and panic handling for bare-metal RV32 targets in `src/runtime.rs`. The reference IR and codegen commands request LLVM IR or assembly together with a static library so rustc performs whole-program LTO and includes the runtime in the generated program. The extra `{output}.a` is a build artifact. Codegen strips debug metadata with `scripts/strip_asm_debug.py`; the IR runner lowers `.ll` with Clang and strips the same unsupported metadata. In both paths, `RUN` receives assembly as `{output}`. These helpers can be removed when you replace the Rust compiler commands.
45: - REIMU under `vendor/REIMU`, pinned as a git submodule. The `RUN` command in `config.mk` invokes it; the test runner does not depend on a particular simulator.
46: - G4 grammar for Rx under `grammar/`. You may use it to generate the lexer and parser for your compiler.
47: 
48: ## Setting up the Makefile
49: 
50: The Makefile is our unified entrypoint in accessing your compiler. You are expected to edit [`config.mk`](config.mk) and hook in your compiler commands. In practice, specify in these fields:
51: 
52: | Command Name | Purpose |
53: | --- | --- |
54: | `BUILD` | Build your compiler once; may be empty. Must exit 0. May write shared runtime assembly to `{runtime}`. |
55: | `SEMANTIC` | Check a complete program through semantic analysis. Exit 0 to accept or 1 to reject. |
56: | `IR` | Write LLVM IR to `{output}` (`.ll`). The runner lowers it to RV32IM assembly with Clang before `RUN`. |
57: | `CODEGEN` | Compile codegen and optimization testcases and write RV32IM assembly to `{output}` for the default `RUN`. |
58: | `RUN` | Run assembly `{output}` with the captured `{runtime}`. Optional `{stdout}` and `{profile}` placeholders select per-execution output and profiling files. |
59: 
60: For example, if your compiler supports `--stage` and `-o` and emits RV32IM assembly:
61: 
62: ```make
63: BUILD = cargo build --release && cp runtime.s {runtime}
64: SEMANTIC = ./target/release/compiler --stage semantic {source}
65: IR = ./target/release/compiler --stage ir {source} -o {output}
66: CODEGEN = ./target/release/compiler --stage codegen {source} -o {output}
67: RUN = xmake run -P vendor/REIMU reimu -f {output},{runtime} -o {stdout} -p {profile} 1>&2
68: ```
69: 
70: REIMU starts at the assembly's global `main` symbol and provides its supported libc functions. `-o {stdout}` saves the program's output for comparison, `-p {profile}` saves its cycle profile, and `1>&2` sends simulator status messages to the stderr log. Do not add `--silent` when collecting cycles: REIMU suppresses profiles in silent mode.
71: 
72: Write any required runtime assembly to `{runtime}` during `BUILD`. Exported functions must follow the ILP32 calling convention. Leave the file empty if the runtime is embedded in the generated program.
73: 
74: IR and codegen use the same testcases. IR uses your `IR` command, then the runner invokes Clang with `-S -x ir --target=riscv32-unknown-none-elf -march=rv32im -mabi=ilp32 -O0 -mllvm -riscv-no-aliases`; codegen uses the assembly produced by `CODEGEN` directly.
75: 
76: ## Testcases
77: 
78: Tests reside in `tests/`, and are organized into subdirectories. We recommend you follow the "namespace:test-suite:testcase" pattern. For instance, `official:semantic:arrays` is the `arrays` testcase in the `semantic` test suite of the `official` namespace.
79: 
80: Each testcase can have one or more source files, optional input and output files and a compulsory `manifest.json` file which defines the format of the testcase. See [the official schema](tests/official/manifest.schema.json) for details. The manifest's `stage` argument determines how the testcase runs: `semantic` uses `SEMANTIC`; each `codegen` entry runs both `IR` → Clang → `RUN` and `CODEGEN` → `RUN`; `optimization` uses `CODEGEN` followed by `RUN`.
81: 
82: You are encouraged to add your own testcases under `tests/custom`. The runner will find them automatically.
83: 
84: Requirements for each kind of testcase:
85: 
86: | Testcase Type | Requirements |
87: | --- | --- |
88: | Semantic | The compiler must exit 0 or 1 to match `compilation_success`. Other exit codes, signals, and timeouts fail the case. |
89: | IR | Compilation must create LLVM `.ll`; Clang must lower it successfully, and every runtime output must match. |
90: | Codegen | Compilation must exit 0 and create `{output}`. Each `io` pair runs the artifact and the output must match the expected file. |
91: | Optimization | Same as Codegen, with cycle reporting when `RUN` provides `{profile}`. |
92: 
93: Testcases with type `lex` and `parse` will be skipped since we already provide the G4 grammar. Extend the Makefile if you want to DIY these stages.
94: 
95: ## Running tests
96: 
97: Run from the project root:
98: 
99: ```sh
100: make test
101: make test FILTER=official:semantic
102: make test FILTER=official:codegen:arrays,official:optimization
103: make test STAGE=ir
104: make test STAGE=codegen FILTER=official:codegen:arrays
105: make test STAGE=ir CLANG=clang-22
106: make test FILTER=custom
107: make test FILTER=official:optimization COMPILE_TIMEOUT=60 RUN_TIMEOUT=30
108: make test VERBOSE=true
109: ```
110: 
111: Supported environment variables include:
112: 
113: - `FILTER`, which selects directories under `tests`, using `:` between folder names and `,` between selections. Omit `FILTER` or leave it empty to run all supported tests.
114: - `STAGE`: optionally run only `semantic`, `ir`, `codegen`, or `optimization`. A directory `FILTER` for codegen fixtures includes both IR and codegen unless `STAGE` restricts it.
115: - `CLANG`: LLVM IR lowering tool, default `clang-22`.
116: - `VERBOSE=true`, which shows every test name and its duration instead of grouped progress. Defaults to `false`.
117: - `COMPILE_TIMEOUT` and `RUN_TIMEOUT`, which override the default timeouts for compilation and execution.
118: 
119: ## CI/CD support
120: 
121: This repo comes with a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests on every push and pull request. You can inspect or modify the workflow in `.github/workflows/`. We advise turning it off while you develop the compiler and turning it back on when the compiler is ready for test-based development.
122: 
123: To disable the test, rename `.github/workflows/test.yml` to `.github/workflows/test.yml.disabled`. GitHub Actions will only discover `*.yml` and `*.yaml` files.

(End of file - total 123 lines)

IR and codegen use the same testcases. IR uses your `IR` command, then the runner invokes Clang with `-S -x ir --target=riscv32-unknown-none-elf -march=rv32im -mabi=ilp32 -O0 -mllvm -riscv-no-aliases`; codegen uses the assembly produced by `CODEGEN` directly.

## Testcases

Tests reside in `tests/`, and are organized into subdirectories. We recommend you follow the "namespace:test-suite:testcase" pattern. For instance, `official:semantic:arrays` is the `arrays` testcase in the `semantic` test suite of the `official` namespace.

Each testcase can have one or more source files, optional input and output files and a compulsory `manifest.json` file which defines the format of the testcase. See [the official schema](tests/official/manifest.schema.json) for details. The manifest's `stage` argument determines how the testcase runs: `semantic` uses `SEMANTIC`; each `codegen` entry runs both `IR` → Clang → `RUN` and `CODEGEN` → `RUN`; `optimization` uses `CODEGEN` followed by `RUN`.

You are encouraged to add your own testcases under `tests/custom`. The runner will find them automatically.

Requirements for each kind of testcase:

| Testcase Type | Requirements |
| --- | --- |
| Semantic | The compiler must exit 0 or 1 to match `compilation_success`. Other exit codes, signals, and timeouts fail the case. |
| IR | Compilation must create LLVM `.ll`; Clang must lower it successfully, and every runtime output must match. |
| Codegen | Compilation must exit 0 and create `{output}`. Each `io` pair runs the artifact and the output must match the expected file. |
| Optimization | Same as Codegen, with cycle reporting when `RUN` provides `{profile}`. |

Testcases with type `lex` and `parse` will be skipped since we already provide the G4 grammar. Extend the Makefile if you want to DIY these stages.

## Running tests

Run from the project root:

```sh
make test
make test FILTER=official:semantic
make test FILTER=official:codegen:arrays,official:optimization
make test STAGE=ir
make test STAGE=codegen FILTER=official:codegen:arrays
make test STAGE=ir CLANG=clang-22
make test FILTER=custom
make test FILTER=official:optimization COMPILE_TIMEOUT=60 RUN_TIMEOUT=30
make test VERBOSE=true
```

Supported environment variables include:

- `FILTER`, which selects directories under `tests`, using `:` between folder names and `,` between selections. Omit `FILTER` or leave it empty to run all supported tests.
- `STAGE`: optionally run only `semantic`, `ir`, `codegen`, or `optimization`. A directory `FILTER` for codegen fixtures includes both IR and codegen unless `STAGE` restricts it.
- `CLANG`: LLVM IR lowering tool, default `clang-22`.
- `VERBOSE=true`, which shows every test name and its duration instead of grouped progress. Defaults to `false`.
- `COMPILE_TIMEOUT` and `RUN_TIMEOUT`, which override the default timeouts for compilation and execution.

## CI/CD support

This repo comes with a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests on every push and pull request. You can inspect or modify the workflow in `.github/workflows/`. We advise turning it off while you develop the compiler and turning it back on when the compiler is ready for test-based development.

To disable the test, rename `.github/workflows/test.yml` to `.github/workflows/test.yml.disabled`. GitHub Actions will only discover `*.yml` and `*.yaml` files.

# Fill in these five commands. See README-EN.md or README-ZH.md for details.

# Optional: build your compiler once before testing. Leave empty if prebuilt.
# {runtime} will be linked into every program.
# Write shared runtime assembly there if your IR/CODEGEN output references it.
BUILD = CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=true cargo build --quiet --locked --release \
    --manifest-path crates/rx/Cargo.toml \
    --target-dir target/reference \
    --target riscv32im-unknown-none-elf && : > {runtime}

# Required for semantic tests: exit 0 to accept {source}, 1 to reject it.
SEMANTIC = RX_SOURCE={source} $(REFERENCE_RUSTC) --cfg rx_semantic \
    --emit=metadata crates/rx/src/entry.rs -o {output}

# Required for IR tests: write RV32 LLVM IR to {output} (.ll).
IR = RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216 RX_SOURCE={source} $(REFERENCE_RUSTC) --crate-type=staticlib \
    --emit=llvm-ir={output},link={output}.a -C opt-level=2 -C lto=fat \
    crates/rx/src/entry.rs

# Required for codegen/optimization tests: write RV32IM assembly to {output} (.s).
CODEGEN = RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216 RX_SOURCE={source} $(REFERENCE_RUSTC) --crate-type=staticlib \
    --emit=asm={output},link={output}.a -C opt-level=2 -C lto=fat \

    --crate-name=rx_test \
    -Awarnings -Aarithmetic_overflow \

364:     value = float(os.environ.get(name, default))

366:         raise TestError(f"{name} must be a positive finite number of seconds")

393:         compile_timeout = positive_timeout("COMPILE_TIMEOUT", "30")
394:         run_timeout = positive_timeout("RUN_TIMEOUT", "10")
395:         args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
396:         directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="run-", dir=args.output_dir.resolve()))
397:         reporter.start(cases, selected_filter, directory)
398:         runtime = directory / "runtime.s"

# Rx Compiler Specification

[](print.html "Print this book")[](https://github.com/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler-specification "Git repository")

# [Rx Compiler Specification](#rx-compiler-specification)

Welcome to the Rx Compiler course! In this course, you are required to write a compiler for a subset of [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/) we call *Rx*. The compiler will target the [RV32IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RISC-V) instruction set architecture. To simplify frontend development, we provide an [ANTLR v4](https://www.antlr.org/) grammar for Rx that automates parsing, allowing you to begin directly with an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST).

The compiler must use LLVM IR as its intermediate representation and support emitting it as text. This lets you validate the frontend using Clang before implementing your own RISC-V backend, as described in [Backend](backend.html#llvm-ir-and-code-generation).

For Rust compatibility, the parser also accepts top-level `use` declarations and lifetime syntax. You may [discard both after parsing](grammar.html#syntax-that-may-be-discarded-after-parsing); import resolution and lifetime checking are not part of the assignment.

This book rigorously defines the syntax and semantics of Rx and, alongside the official Rust compiler (`rustc`), serves as the source of truth for this course. If you find any ambiguities or disagreements between the two, do not hesitate to reach out to your TA for clarification.

## [How to read the specification](#how-to-read-the-specification)

Start by reading [Language scope and test guarantees](undefined-behavior.html), which distinguishes valid programs, compile errors, and excluded cases (i.e., *undefined behavior*) to understand which features are required and which are out of scope.

Next, proceed to [lexical structure](lexical-structure.html), followed by [items](items.html), [types](types.html), and [expressions](expressions.html). These sections define the complete grammar of the Rx language. There is a quick lookup table in the [grammar summary](grammar-summary.html) section.

While reading, we recommend experimenting with the Rust compiler (`rustc`). You can also use online environments such as the [Rust Playground](https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=stable&mode=debug&edition=2024) or [Compiler Explorer](https://godbolt.org/) to see what compiles and what does not. Note that we **do not treat compiler warnings as compile errors**.

## [How to get started](#how-to-get-started)

Before beginning, we recommend reviewing an introductory Rust tutorial. You do not need an exhaustive understanding because Rx implements only a subset, but familiarity with basic Rust syntax is essential.

Many excellent online resources explain the various phases of compiler construction. Some blogs from your TAs (or their TAs) include:

-   [Compiler for Mx\* 编译器随笔](https://darksharpness.top/CompilerMx/) by legendary TA [@darksharpness](https://darksharpness.top/): A classic blog post that focuses heavily on various optimization techniques in Mx (the course language used prior to Rx).
-   [Writing a Compiler for Rust](https://norb.space/blog/writing-a-compiler-for-rust) by RayZh (co-designer of this specification): Focuses primarily on the end-to-end compiler pipeline. Note that certain techniques discussed are no longer needed or applicable due to updates in this year’s specification.

Additional information:

-   [Compiler 101](https://github.com/ACMClassCourses/Compiler-101): A collection of projects and notes by ACM Class students over the years. Note that many of the techniques described are specific to Mx and may not apply to Rx.
-   [The Rust Reference](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/): The official, comprehensive reference for the Rust language. While this Rx specification is intended to be self-contained, the Rust Reference is an authoritative supplementary guide to standard Rust semantics.
-   [Rust Compiler Development Guide](https://rustc-dev-guide.rust-lang.org/): An advanced, in-depth guide to `rustc` internals and architecture, recommended as a background reference for compiler engineering patterns.

# Rx Compiler Specification

[](print.html "Print this book")[](https://github.com/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler-specification "Git repository")

# [Language scope and test guarantees](#language-scope-and-test-guarantees)

## [Definition](#definition)

We distinguish among valid programs, compile errors, and undefined behavior:

Category

Compiler requirement

Test policy

Valid program

Compile and produce the specified behavior

May appear in any applicable test

Compile error

Reject normally; diagnostic wording is unspecified

May appear in negative tests

Undefined behavior

No required diagnostic or behavior

Excluded as stated by its defining rule

Unsupported syntax may be rejected at the language-subset boundary even if the supplied parser recognizes it. Unless a source form is explicitly classified as undefined behavior, ordinary name, type, and place-mutability errors remain compile errors, including in unreachable code. The compiler need not prove termination, borrow validity, or ownership validity. Runtime checks, panic handling, and stack unwinding are not required for excluded executions.

## [Language subset](#language-subset)

Rx is a subset of Rust 2021. Every Rx source program uses valid Rust syntax, but this specification defines its own built-in environment and required runtime behavior.

Rx includes:

-   Functions, named-field structs, constants, and inherent implementations.
-   Top-level [use declarations](items/use-declarations.html) for Rust compatibility, ignored after parsing.
-   Identifier bindings and local type inference.
-   Integers, booleans, fixed arrays, references, and builtin `Box` and `Vec` containers.
-   `if`, `while`, `loop`, `return`, `break`, and `continue` control flow.
-   Struct derives for `Copy`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, and `Eq`.

The Rx subset excludes:

-   User traits, trait bounds, and trait objects.
-   Enums, non-unit tuples, tuple structs, tuple variants, and unit variants.
-   Pattern matching, destructuring, and guards.
-   Type parameters and general generics. Lifetime syntax is supported, but its validity is guaranteed rather than checked.
-   Module declarations and import resolution, visibility, privacy, macros, and arbitrary attributes. Use declarations are accepted only as described by the [use compatibility guarantee](#use-compatibility).
-   Unsafe Rust and the standard library beyond the builtins defined here.
-   Const generics and general constant evaluation beyond the restricted [constant contexts](const_eval.html). Constant propagation remains an optional optimization.
-   Integer overflow checks.

[Types](types.html), [expressions](expressions.html), and the [grammar summary](grammar-summary.html) define the complete subset. Forms outside that grammar are unsupported.

## [Test guarantees](#test-guarantees)

The following source forms trigger undefined behavior and will never appear in test suites, including within unreachable code or constant contexts where applicable:

Undefined behavior

Defining rules

Integer literal outside its determined type

[Integer literal range](#integer-literal-range)

Integer inference requiring expected-type propagation through binary operations, unary operations, or shared/mutable borrows

[Expected-type propagation](types.html#coercion-sites-and-expected-types)

Omitting the explicit concrete type argument in a `Box::new(...)` or `Vec::new()` constructor call

[Builtin constructors](heap.html#builtin-signatures)

Using a function as a value

[Function values](expressions/path-expr.html#function-values)

Declaring a struct named `u32`, `isize`, `usize`, `bool`, `Box`, `Vec`, `Copy`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, or `Eq`

[Protected builtin names](names.html#protected-builtin-names)

Local binding named `get_i32`, `print_i32`, or `println_i32`

[Protected builtin names](names.html#protected-builtin-names)

Place-mutability violation in unreachable code, including assignment, mutable borrowing, or mutable receiver adjustment

[Unreachable code](types/never.html#unreachable-code)

Array or `Vec` index operand with the never type `!`

[Index operand types](expressions/array-expr.html#index-operand-types)

Documentation comment (`///`, `//!`, `/**`, `/*!`)

[Documentation comments](comments.html#documentation-comments)

Let or parameter name colliding with a visible unqualified constant

[Constant-name collisions](#constant-name-collisions)

Equality between different source types

[Cross-type equality](#cross-type-equality)

LUB coercion for which neither type can become the common target

[Least upper bound coercions](types.html#least-upper-bound-coercions)

Multiple distinct matching methods in a dot call

[Method lookup](expressions/method-call-expr.html#method-lookup)

Use declaration violating the Rust compatibility guarantees

[Use compatibility](#use-compatibility)

Invalid lifetime declaration, use, bound, or elision

[Lifetime validity](#lifetime-validity)

Observable zero-sized data use outside the unit-result exception

[Zero-sized data](#zero-sized-data)

These guarantees constrain valid source programs. Any invalid memory access, incorrect termination, or incorrect program output introduced during compilation remains a compiler defect.

### [Integer literal range](#integer-literal-range)

An integer literal’s type is selected by its suffix, its expected integer type, or the `i32` fallback, in that order. An unsuffixed integer literal whose value falls outside the `i32` range when evaluated without an expected type constitutes undefined behavior.

Integer literal overflow exhibits undefined behavior. The [literal rules](expressions/literal-expr.html#integer-typing-and-range) still permit signed minima such as `-2147483648i32` and `-(2147483648i32)`.

### [Constant-name collisions](#constant-name-collisions)

A `let` binding or function parameter whose name matches a visible unqualified constant triggers undefined behavior, regardless of mutability or declaration order. No diagnostic or constant-pattern interpretation is required. An associated constant reachable only as `Type::NAME` does not exclude a local `NAME`. Collisions with builtin names follow the [protected builtin rules](names.html#protected-builtin-names).

### [Cross-type equality](#cross-type-equality)

Applying `==` or `!=` to operands of differing source types triggers undefined behavior. No diagnostic, coercion, or cross-type `PartialEq` implementation is required. This includes shared versus mutable references, different array types, different container element types, and `Vec` versus array comparisons.

The [equality rules](builtin-traits.html#partialeq) define operand types, capability requirements, and same-type comparison. Lifetime arguments alone do not distinguish source types under [type identity](types.html#supported-types).

### [Use compatibility](#use-compatibility)

Tests may contain [use declarations](items/use-declarations.html), such as `use rx::core::*;`, to compile the same source with Rust and the course support crate. Their import paths and combinations are valid in that Rust environment. Any imported name used by the program denotes an Rx builtin under its existing spelling; unused imports and aliases are allowed. Tests never rely on a use declaration to introduce another type, value, module, or usable alias into Rx.

Violations of these guarantees constitute undefined behavior and will not appear in any positive, negative, or performance test. The compiler need not resolve imports or diagnose missing imported items, conflicting imports, or other import validity errors. Malformed use syntax must still be rejected by the parser with a standard syntax error. After discarding use declarations, ordinary name, type, and place-mutability errors elsewhere in the program remain compile errors.

### [Lifetime validity](#lifetime-validity)

Lifetime declarations, annotations, arguments, bounds, and elision follow the supported Rust 2021 rules described in [References](references.html#lifetime-validity). Tests guarantee their validity throughout the program. Invalid lifetime use is undefined behavior and appears in no positive, negative, or performance test.

The compiler may discard this lifetime syntax after parsing and need not carry it through semantic analysis or LLVM IR generation. The [parser conventions](grammar.html#syntax-that-may-be-discarded-after-parsing) explain which information remains necessary.

Excluded lifetime errors

Tests exclude undeclared or duplicate lifetimes, invalid shadowing, incorrect argument counts or placement, forbidden explicit late-bound arguments, ambiguous missing annotations, unsatisfied outlives bounds, invalid `'static` claims, rejected unused parameters, and bodies or uses that fail to uphold their annotations.

Malformed tokens and syntax retain their ordinary lexer and parser behavior. Other type and place-mutability errors remain compile errors. No lifetime or ownership checker is required; actual references must still obey the [borrowing rules](references.html#borrowing-rules).

### [Zero-sized data](#zero-sized-data)

Unit `()` is valid as a function or control-flow result.

Excluded zero-sized uses

All other uses requiring observable zero-sized storage are undefined behavior, including:

-   Zero-sized parameters, bindings, constants, statics, or assignment destinations.
-   Empty structs or zero-sized fields.
-   Zero-length arrays or zero-sized array elements.
-   References to zero-sized values and dereferences of zero-sized data.

An empty `Vec<T>` with nonzero-sized `T` is valid and is not itself zero-sized. Its representation is implementation-defined.

Resource limits, stack size, allocation policy, and output constraints are part of the [backend contract](backend.html#resource-guarantees).

## [Syntax that may be discarded after parsing](#syntax-that-may-be-discarded-after-parsing)

Two forms of Rust compatibility syntax must be parsed, but need no subsequent semantic processing or LLVM IR representation:

-   [Use declarations](items/use-declarations.html): discard the entire declaration. No import resolution, module loading, alias insertion, or import-conflict checking is required.
-   Lifetime syntax: discard lifetime parameter declarations, reference lifetime annotations, explicit lifetime arguments, outlives bounds, and lifetime where clauses. No lifetime name resolution, inference, elision checking, or lifetime/borrow checker is required.

The [use compatibility](undefined-behavior.html#use-compatibility) and [lifetime validity](undefined-behavior.html#lifetime-validity) guarantees exclude tests that would require these checks. Discarding lifetime syntax is an internal AST transformation; the compiler is not required to ensure that source text stripped of lifetime annotations forms valid Rust.

Parsing must still enforce the grammar of these constructs. The compiler must preserve reference types, mutability qualifiers, concrete type arguments (such as `i32` in `Vec::<&'a i32>`), and all other AST structures. Ordinary name, type, and place-mutability checks and correct reference behavior remain required.

## [Contextual punctuation](#contextual-punctuation)

The parser interprets combined punctuation according to its current grammar context. The lexer may emit a combined token; the parser consumes the needed prefix and leaves the remaining punctuation for the enclosing construct.

Combined token

Context

Interpretation

`&&`

Reference type or prefix borrow

Two `&` tokens, as in `&&i32` or `&&x`

`>>`

Closing nested type arguments

Two closing `>` tokens

`>=`

Closing type arguments before assignment

A closing `>` followed by `=`

`>>=`

Closing nested type arguments before assignment

Two closing `>` tokens followed by `=`

In ordinary infix expression contexts, these tokens denote their corresponding operators. Thus, the following variable initializations do not require whitespace between the closing `>` and the `=` token:

```rust
let values: Vec<i32>=Vec::<i32>::new();
let nested: Vec<Vec<i32>>=Vec::<Vec<i32>>::new();
```

# Rx compiler test cases

[](#rx-compiler-test-cases)

[English](/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler-testcases/blob/master/README-EN.md) | [简体中文](/ACMClassCourse-2025/rx-compiler-testcases/blob/master/README-ZH.md)

Welcome to the Rx Compiler course! This repository contains the test cases for the Rx compiler course. The files are organized by the compiler stage or kind of workload they exercise. A test runner discovers test cases from `manifest.json` files.

### Test families

[](#test-families)

-   **`lexer/`** contains tokenization tests. `accept/` holds inputs that should lex successfully and `reject/` holds malformed inputs that should be rejected.
-   **`parser/`** contains syntax tests with the same `accept/` and `reject/` split.
-   **`semantic/`** contains feature-oriented programs that are checked through semantic analysis. A manifest can contain both accepted and rejected programs, distinguished by `compilation_success`.
-   **`codegen/`** contains programs that must compile and run. Each test run supplies stdin and the expected stdout for one execution.
-   **`optimization/`** contains larger or optimization-sensitive runtime workloads.

## Files in a test directory

[](#files-in-a-test-directory)

-   **`.rx`** — an Rx source program.
-   **`.in`** — stdin for one runtime execution. A manifest may use `null` when a case needs empty stdin instead of a file.
-   **`.out`** — the exact stdout expected from the corresponding execution. Use an empty file when the program should print nothing.
-   **`manifest.json`** — a nonempty JSON array describing the cases in that directory. Paths in the manifest are relative to the manifest's directory.

The usual runtime naming pattern keeps test input and output files beside their source, for example:

```
codegen/integer-arithmetic/
├── manifest.json
├── acc-...-i32.rx
├── acc-...-i32.mixed.in
└── acc-...-i32.mixed.out
```

One source can have several `io` pairs, which is useful for smoke, boundary, large, or otherwise distinct input scenarios.

## Manifest format

[](#manifest-format)

`manifest.schema.json` is the JSON Schema for `manifest.json`. Each entry contains:

{
  "source": "program.rx",
  "stage": "semantic",
  "compilation\_success": true,
  "description": "Optional explanation",
  "metadata": {}
}

The fields are:

-   **`source`** — one source file for the entry.
-   **`stage`** — one of `lex`, `parse`, `semantic`, `codegen`, or `optimization`.
-   **`compilation_success`** — whether the source is expected to pass that stage. A normal rejection is a valid negative result; a crash, signal, or timeout is not.
-   **`io`** — one or more `{ "input", "output" }` pairs. This is required for `codegen` and `optimization` entries, which must compile successfully before their generated program is run.
-   **`description`** — an optional human-readable purpose or explanation for a case, especially a negative case.
-   **`metadata`** — optional authoring or provenance information. It can record hashes, upstream origins, tokens, and similar details.

Now I have a good picture of the semantic test suites (feature-oriented). AST acceptance likely requires:
- Lexer/parser integrated using ANTLR g4
- AST construction
- Name resolution and type checking (semantic analysis) so that SEMANTIC tests pass (accept valid, reject invalid)
- Code review: clean code, AST design, error handling

The spec says "we provide an ANTLR v4 grammar for Rx that automates parsing, allowing you to begin directly with an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)". So the AST stage = parser output to AST + semantic analysis? Hmm, "AST 验收" might just be the AST + semantic checks. Since the makefile's SEMANTIC command performs semantic analysis and official semantic tests are run at AST stage, I think AST acceptance = pass semantic tests + AST code review.

Let me verify what the AST stage expected deliverable is. There might be course-specific docs beyond the spec. Let me look at the template's README-ZH.md maybe it has more details (it's the same). Let me check the GitHub template repo maybe has a docs/ or the course website with assignment details. The starting letter mentions the spec link. There may be an online judge for AST? Hmm.

Actually, "第4周周日 23:59 AST 验收" - acceptance is likely in-person code review + demo of parser/AST/semantic. The exact criteria unknown; likely running `make test FILTER=official:semantic` (all semantic tests pass) and reviewing AST code.

Let me now think about what the todolist should contain. The user said "先到 AST 完成为止，后面不用梳理" - plan up to AST completion only. Also "有问题直接询问我" - ask questions if any.

I have some genuine questions:
1. Implementation language choice: Java / Modern C++ / Rust? This drastically affects setup steps (ANTLR runtime, project layout). The starting letter says "编译器语言 Java、Modern C++ 或 Rust". The grammar is target-agnostic. Recommend Rust? Hmm. Since the user's repo is a Rust-based template and the reference is rustc, but implementing in Rust with antlr4rust? The known antlr4rust crate is not very mature. Java has first-class ANTLR support. Modern C++ has ANTLR C++ runtime. Rust's antlr4rust (e.g., `antlr-rust` crate) exists. Let me ask the user which language they prefer (Java recommended for ANTLR maturity). But wait - maybe the user already has a preference based on their course requirements. I should ask.

2. What exactly does AST acceptance require? I can state my understanding: pass official semantic tests + code review of AST/semantic analysis. Maybe ask the user to confirm if they know what the TA expects for AST acceptance (e.g., whether AST printing/debug output required).

3. Should the todolist include environment setup (submodules, REIMU, rustup, clang) even though not strictly AST? Yes, needed for testing.

4. Language of the todolist: Chinese presumably. I'll write in Chinese.

Before asking, let me check a bit more: the template README-ZH.md possibly same; check GitHub workflow to see what tests run by default. Also check the semantic tests count. Maybe I can clone the testcases submodule - but network works (git ls-remote succeeded). Should I initialize submodules? That's a step toward setup; but the user asked only to produce todolist. Initializing submodules modifies the working tree. I'd rather not without asking. But knowing the number of semantic testcases would help make the plan realistic. display.text:
name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential

      - name: Install Clang 22 for LLVM IR tests
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/llvm.gpg
          echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/llvm.gpg] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-22 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/llvm.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y clang-22

      - name: Set up xmake
        uses: xmake-io/github-action-setup-xmake@v1
        with:
          xmake-version: latest

      - name: Build REIMU
        run: |
          xmake f -y -P vendor/REIMU -m release -o target/reimu
          xmake -y -P vendor/REIMU

      - name: Set up Rust
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --target riscv32im-unknown-none-elf
          rustup default 1.95.0

      - name: Run tests
        run: make test

[ANTLR4](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4) runtime for Rust programming language.

For examples you can see [grammars](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/grammars), [tests/gen](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/tests/gen) for corresponding generated code and [tests/my\_tests.rs](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/tests/my_test.rs) for actual usage examples

## ANTLR4 Tool(parser generator)

[](#antlr4-toolparser-generator)

Generator part is currently located in rust-target branch of my antlr4 fork [rrevenantt/antlr4/tree/rust-target](https://github.com/rrevenantt/antlr4/tree/rust-target) Latest version is automatically built to [releases](https://github.com/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/releases) on this repository. So if you just want to generate parser or if you want to contribute to only runtime part you don't have to do build it yourself.

But if you want to build or change generator yourself:

-   `git clone -b rust-target https://github.com/rrevenantt/antlr4` - clone my antlr4 fork
-   `git submodule update --init --recursive --remote` - update Rust target submodule
-   `mvn -DskipTests install` - build generator

### Implementation status

[](#implementation-status)

For now development is going on in this repository but eventually it will be merged to main ANTLR4 repo

Since version `0.3` works on stable rust. Previous versions are not maintained any more so in case of nightly breakage you should migrate to the latest version.

### Usage

[](#usage)

You should use the ANTLR4 "tool" to generate a parser, that will use the ANTLR runtime located here. You can run it with the following command:

java -jar <path to ANTLR4 tool\> -Dlanguage=Rust MyGrammar.g4

For a full list of antlr4 tool options, please visit the [tool documentation page](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/blob/master/doc/tool-options.md).

You can also see [build.rs](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/build.rs) as an example of `build.rs` configuration to rebuild parser automatically if grammar file was changed.

Then add following to `Cargo.toml` of the crate from which generated parser is going to be used:

\[dependencies\]
antlr-rust = "0.3"

### Parse Tree structure

[](#parse-tree-structure)

It is possible to generate idiomatic Rust syntax trees. For this you would need to use labels feature of ANTLR tool. You can see [Labels](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/grammars/Labels.g4) grammar for example. Consider following rule :

```
e   : a=e op='*' b=e   # mult
    | left=e '+' b=e   # add
		 
```

For such rule ANTLR will generate enum `EContextAll` containing `mult` and `add` alternatives, so you will be able to match on them in your code. Also corresponding struct for each alternative will contain fields you labeled. I.e. for `MultContext` struct will contain `a` and `b` fields containing child subtrees and `op` field with `TerminalNode` type which corresponds to individual `Token`. It also is possible to disable generic parse tree creation to keep only selected children via `parser.build_parse_trees = false`, but unfortunately currently it will prevent visitors from working.

### Differences with Java

[](#differences-with-java)

Although Rust runtime API has been made as close as possible to Java, there are quite some differences because Rust is not an OOP language and is much more explicit.

-   If you are using labeled alternatives, struct generated for the rule is an enum with variant for each alternative
-   Parser needs to have ownership for listeners, but it is possible to get listener back via `ListenerId` otherwise `ParseTreeWalker` should be used.
-   In embedded actions to access parser you should use `recog` variable instead of `self`/`this`. This is because predicates have to be inserted into two syntactically different places in generated parser and in one of them it is impossible to have parser as `self`.
-   str based `InputStream` have different index behavior when there are unicode characters. If you need exactly the same behavior, use `[u32]` based `InputStream`, or implement custom `CharStream`.
-   In actions you have to escape `'` in rust lifetimes with `\` because ANTLR considers them as strings, e.g. `Struct<\'lifetime>`
-   To make custom tokens you should use `@tokenfactory` custom action, instead of usual `TokenLabelType` parser option. ANTLR parser options can accept only single identifiers while Rust target needs know about lifetime as well. Also in Rust target `TokenFactory` is the way to specify token type. As example you can see [CSV](/rrevenantt/antlr4rust/blob/master/grammars/CSV.g4) test grammar.
-   All rule context variables (rule argument or rule return) should implement `Default + Clone`.

### Benchmarks

[](#benchmarks)

Here is comparison of antlr generated XML lexer and parser (from default XML grammar but with custom minimal Token/TokenFactory/InputStream/RuleContext) to hand-written implementations in rust ecosystem. Keep in mind that `xmlparser` and `quick_xml` are much closer to being lexer than parser, so they should be compared with antlr lexer. Also while structs used by generated lexer and parser were customized to track as minimum data as required (which is possible by any user of antlr-rust), internals of the lexer cannot be customized enough yet and still track quite a lot of data that might not be used in particular case. So there is still room for improvement.

# 名称与作用域（names.html）
1. 顶层函数/结构体/常量/固有 impl 关联项引入名称；参数/let 引入局部绑定；字段属所在结构体命名空间、按接收者类型解析。

4. 类型/值命名空间分离：类型位置的结构体/基元/Box/Vec/Self 属类型名空间；表达式位置的函数/常量/局部/self 属值名空间；`Type::member` 前缀属类型名空间；字段属该结构体字段名空间。
5. 具名字段结构体不是可调用值构造器，故结构体与函数可同名。
6. 顶层名在各自命名空间内唯一；结构体字段唯一；函数参数唯一。
7. 结构体全部固有 impl 共享一个关联值命名空间；重复方法/关联函数/关联常量（含跨 impl、不论签名）=> 编译错误；字段与固有方法可同名。
8. let 可遮蔽早先局部/参数/非受保护全局函数；查找取最近绑定；最近绑定不可调用时调用是编译错误，不回退外层被遮蔽函数。
9. let 初始化器在新绑定之前的 scope 求值。
10. self=方法接收者；Self=当前声明结构体/impl 目标类型（关联项内可用）；Self 不能出现在 impl 外的顶层函数；生命周期名独立命名空间。
11. 保护名：类型名空间 `i32,u32,isize,usize,bool,Box,Vec,Copy,Clone,PartialEq,Eq`；值名空间 `get_i32,print_i32,println_i32`；derive 入口 `Copy,Clone,PartialEq,Eq`。
12. 保护名仍是合法词法标识符，可用于其他名空间或字段/关联项名（字段名 Vec 合法）；固有 impl 只能对用户结构体，不能给保护内建类型加固有方法。
13. UB：声明结构体名为 u32/isize/usize/bool/Box/Vec/Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq；局部绑定或普通参数名为 get_i32/print_i32/println_i32。
14. 编译错误：其他在各自名空间重声明保护名，含 struct i32、顶层函数/常量使用保护 I/O 名。
15. UB：let/参数名与可见非限定常量同名（constant-name collision，不论 mut/声明顺序）；仅 `Type::NAME` 可达的关联常量不豁免局部同名。

# 类型与推断（types.html）
16. 支持类型：i32/isize/u32/usize（四种互不相同）、bool、具名结构体、`[T;N]`（N 为受限 usize 常量）、`&T/&mut T/&'a T/&'a mut T`、`()`、`Box<T>`、`Vec<T>`；发散表达式内部 never。
17. 结构体名义，引用/数组/Box/Vec 结构化；数组长度按值比较（`[i32;4]`=`[i32;(4usize)]`）；引用同一 iff referent 类型与可变性都匹配；生命周期实参不区分引用类型。
18. 推断只填 let 省略类型；函数/项签名显式；每绑定类型固定、后续使用不改；Box/Vec 构造省略显式具体类型实参 => UB；字段/方法查找前接收者类型须已知。
19. 整数字面量类型确定顺序：①后缀固定；②无后缀用 expected type（限 i32/u32/isize/usize 之一）；③否则 i32。
20. 无 expected 时，另一操作数、邻近数组元素/分支、绑定后续使用都不选字面量类型；选定后不隐式改变；字面量大小不影响类型选择。
21. expected-type 位点（one-to-one coercion）：带标注 let 初始化器→标注；常量初始化器→声明类型（受常量形式限制）；赋值右操作数→目标；函数/方法/容器构造实参→声明形参（接收者按 receiver adjustment）；函数尾/return→声明结果；结构体字段初始化器→声明字段类型。
22. 传播路径：穿过括号、进入块尾表达式、if 两分支结果、同一 loop 的所有 break 值；expected 数组类型 `[T;N]` 向每个列出/重复元素供给 T 且要求长度 N。
23. 传播不穿透二元/一元运算与借用（`&e`/`&mut e`），也不回看早期绑定初始化器；需要该传播来确定整数类型 => UB。
24. 条件必须 bool（整数不能当条件、无隐式转换）；数组长度与索引 expected type=usize；loop 体与无 else 的 if 结果要求 `()`。
25. LUB（无 expected 时，用于 if-with-else 两分支/数组字面量元素/同一 loop 的所有 break 值）：按源码序、忽略 never；首个其余结果类型为 T，后继 U：`U→T` 则保持；否则若 `T→U` 且早先结果均可调整到 U 则改用 U 并调整；再不行 => UB（不找第三类型）；全 never=>never；空数组看零大小排除；裸 `break;` 给 `()`；嵌套 loop 的 break 不参与。
26. `as` 仅支持 int↔int、bool→int；int cast 保留 32 位模式；false→0、true→1；不支持 int→bool、引用→int；cast 目标不向操作数给 expected（`1 as u32` 中 1 为 i32）。
27. coercion 调整仅：`T→T`；`&mut T→&T`；`&S/&mut S→&T`（内建 deref `&U→U`、`&mut U→U`、`Box<U>→U`，可重复至 referent 精确匹配）；`&mut S→&mut T`（须外层 `&mut` 且路径无共享引用）；Never→任意。Vec 无内建 deref。
28. 不隐式借用 owned 值：`Box<T>` 不能 coercion 到 T 或 `&T`（写 `&boxed`）；不转换已存数组/容器元素、不改内层引用可变性、不产 slice（`&mut &mut i32` 不可到 `&mut &i32`）；数组字面量各元素是独立位点可各自 coercion。
29. 可变引用 reborrow（规范注明本项目无需掌握）：coercion site 处 `&mut T` 可重借为 `&mut T`；未标注 let 则 move 引用。
30. 递归：按值结构体/数组包含环（含内联数组）无有限大小 => 编译错误；Box/Vec/引用提供 indirection，支持递归与互递归；Box 非空，有限布局不等于可构造（Chain）。

# Box 与 Vec（heap.html）
31. 签名（T=容器具体实参；new 为无接收者关联函数；其余为方法；不要求 T 具备内建 trait 能力；实参遵循普通调用/coercion 规则）：
32. `Box<T>: fn new(value: T) -> Box<T>`（移动/复制 value 进新自有存储）。
33. `Vec<T>: fn new() -> Vec<T>`（空）；`fn len(&self) -> usize`；`fn is_empty(&self) -> bool`。
34. `Vec<T>: fn push(&mut self, value: T) -> ()`（按 copy/move 追加）。
35. `Vec<T>: fn remove(&mut self, index: usize) -> T`（移出返回，后续左移，保序，支持非 Copy/非 Clone）。
36. 调用形式：`Box::<i32>::new(7)`、`Vec::<i32>::new()`；所有容器构造（含嵌套）必须显式具体类型实参；省略（`Box::new(7)`/`Vec::new()`）=> UB；T 内生命周期遵循 lifetime 规则；类型位置 `_` 不支持。
37. 容器 Clone（当 T: Clone）：`Box<T>: fn clone(&self)->Box<T>`（独立存储克隆 T）；`Vec<T>: fn clone(&self)->Vec<T>`（按序克隆等长独立 vector）；owned 嵌套容器递归克隆，共享引用只复制引用不克隆目标。
38. 点调用 `.clone()` 受 competing-method exclusion；完全限定 `Box::<i32>::clone(&boxed)` 直接选容器操作。
39. Box 访问：`*b` 为 T place；经可变 owner/`&mut` 可变，共享访问只读；owned Box 的 `*` 不插入共享借用；读 Copy 内容复制、读非 Copy 从 owned Box 移动；移动后的分配可保留至程序结束。
40. Vec 索引/删除要求 index<len，越界执行被排除（不要求检查/panic）；`v[index]` 为 T place；读 Copy 元素复制，直接移动非 Copy 索引元素 => UB（须用 remove）；可变索引 place 可赋值。
41. Vec 索引隐式借用：共享读取与 `&mut T→&T` 只需共享访问；赋值/复合赋值/可变借用或 reborrow/`&mut self` 接收者需该索引步骤可变访问，且穿越字段、后续索引、Box deref、元素内 `&mut` 仍持续；Vec 自身不可解引用、不 coercion 为元素/slice 引用。
42. 数组索引与 owned Box 解引用不插入容器借用，故其中 `&mut T` 可经不可变 owner 继续可用（位置决定可变性）。
43. Box 相等比较存储值；Vec 相等比较长度与逐元素，忽略地址/capacity/padding；零大小堆对象 => UB；非零 T 的空 Vec 合法；分配须在 32 位 usize 地址空间内且不依赖分配失败。
44. 堆清理：学生代码无需释放、允许泄漏；移动仍转移所有权、克隆仍独立、重分配/remove 失效的引用仍无效。

# 内置 I/O 与入口（undefined-behavior/builtin.html）
45. main：`fn main() -> ()`；返回类型标注可省略；空参数表、无泛型参数。
46. 入口调用源 main，初始调用完成后返回状态码 0；实现建议源函数用唯一 mangled 符号、导出 C ABI wrapper `main`，wrapper 调源函数并返回有符号 32 位 0。
47. `fn get_i32() -> i32`（stdin 读有符号十进制 i32；测试保证输入充分、有效、范围内、ASCII 空白分隔，格式错/提前 EOF 排除）。
48. `fn print_i32(value: i32) -> ()`（写有符号十进制，无附加字符）；`fn println_i32(value: i32) -> ()`（同上并追加 `'\n'` 0x0A）。
49. 其他整数类型实参须显式 cast（`print_i32(x as i32)`）；unit 结果可作表达式语句丢弃，不允许普通零大小绑定。

# Builtin traits（builtin-traits.html）
50. 编译器识别 Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq；结构体经 derive 实现；唯一内建 trait 操作 `.clone()`、`==`、`!=`。
51. Copy：marker、无方法；读取 place 复制 Copy 值、移动其他（初始化/赋值/按值实参/接收者/返回/字段读取）；复制语义独立，复制 `&T` 只复制引用；值传递须保持按值语义。
52. 派生 Copy 要求：每一字段实现 Copy，且同一结构体必须显式 derive Clone（即使 bitwise copy 可行也须显式 derive Copy）。
53. Clone：`fn clone(&self)->Self`；派生递归克隆所有字段与数组元素为独立值；标量与共享引用被复制（不克隆引用目标）；Box/Vec 克隆见 heap。
54. 派生 Clone 要求：每字段 Clone；`&mut T` 不是 Clone。
55. PartialEq：启用 `==`/`!=`，借用两操作数；标量按值、数组逐元素、结构体逐字段、引用比较 referent 而非地址；忽略 padding（整体 memcmp 一般无效）；Box/Vec 按容器相等。
56. 派生 PartialEq 要求：每字段 PartialEq；两操作数必须同一源类型且该类型实现 PartialEq；相等运算符不做隐式 coercion、不从对侧操作数推断无后缀整数字面量：`1==1i32` 合法，`1==1u32`=>UB。
57. Eq：标记相等为等价关系（自反/对称/传递），不引入新操作（仍用 PartialEq）；派生 Eq 要求每字段 Eq 且 PartialEq 已显式 derive。
58. 能力表：整数/bool：Copy 是、Clone 是、PartialEq/Eq 两者；`&T`：Copy/Clone 是、相等需 T 对应能力；`&mut T`：Copy/Clone 否、相等需 T 对应能力；`[T;N]`：Copy/Clone/相等按 T；Struct：均须显式 derive；`Box<T>/Vec<T>`：Copy 否、Clone 当 T:Clone、相等当 T 有对应能力。
59. 递归类型能力验证须终止但仍逐字段执行要求（`Node{children:Vec<Node>}` 可 derive Clone/PartialEq/Eq，只要其他字段满足）。

# 常量上下文（const_eval.html）
60. 常量上下文仅：const 项初始化器、数组类型长度、数组重复长度。
61. ConstValue 语法：`INTEGER_LITERAL | true | false | ConstantPath | -Magnitude | (ConstValue)`；Magnitude: `INTEGER_LITERAL | ConstantPath | (Magnitude)`；ConstantPath: PathInExpression。
62. ConstantPath 必须解析为常量项：直接或关联常量路径（`LIMIT`、`Config::LIMIT`、`Self::LIMIT`）；指向局部/函数/其他值 => 静态形式错误。
63. 允许形式：123、LIMIT、-LIMIT、(-1)、-(1)、((true))、有效后缀与基数；其他表达式 => 静态形式错误。
64. 常量路径递归求值；常量项可在使用者前或后声明；依赖图须无环，自引用或 A→B→A => 编译错误，且须在求值前检测。
65. 类型/范围：常量路径取目标项声明类型与值；const 初始化器有声明 expected type；数组长度 expected type=usize；字面量类型/有符号最小值遵循整数字面量规则；超范围 => UB，其余普通类型/受限形式错误仍是编译错误。
66. `const N: isize = -1;` => UB（需 expected 穿透一元负号），写 `-1isize`；`const N: i32 = -1;` 合法（默认 i32）。
67. `[expr; 4]` 的元素表达式是普通表达式，仅长度是常量上下文；运行时表达式的常量传播/折叠是可选优化，不改变语义。

# 运算符与表达式类型要求（operator-expr.html 等）
68. 算术 `+ - * / %`：两操作数各为 T 或 `&T`、同一个整数 T => T；无隐式整数转换；一元 `-` 需有符号 I 或 `&I` => I。
69. 位 `& | ^`：两操作数同为整数或 bool T（各 T 或 `&T`）=> T；一元 `!`：整数或 bool T 或 `&T` => T。
70. 移位 `<< >>`：左 L 或 `&L`、右 R 或 `&R`（L/R 可不同整数）=> L；运行时移位量按低 5 位掩码；有符号右移算术、无符号逻辑；常量折叠也掩码。
71. 复合赋值：目标为可变 place 基元类型 T、右侧 T 或 `&T` => ()；移位复合：目标可变整数 place L、右侧 R 或 `&R` => ()；不从目标推断右侧（`n:u32` 的 `n += 1`=>UB，`n += 1u32` 合法）。
72. 引用操作数仅一层共享引用：`&a+&b`、`-&a`、`x+=&y` 支持；`&&a+&b`、`-&mut a`、`x+=&mut y` 不支持；引用赋值目标不自动 deref（用 `*p += rhs`）。
73. 整数 32 位；`+ - *` 与有符号取负按二进制补码 wrap（=关闭溢出检查），优化/未优化一致；除零、i32::MIN `/-1` 或 `%-1` 被排除（不要求检查/panic）；除法向零截断、非零余数随被除数符号。
74. 比较：`==`/`!=` 用 PartialEq 规则，不同源类型=>UB；`< <= > >=` 仅匹配整数类型与 bool（false 在前）；引用比较 referent 值非地址，各层可变性匹配且终为同一标量；额外允许左 `&T`、右 `&mut T`（调为 `&T`，同 referent，operator-specific）；`&mut a<&b`、`&&a<&&mut b`、`a<&b` 不可；排序不自动经 Box deref。
75. `&&`/`||` 要求 bool、返回 bool、短路、无引用变体、无整数 truthiness；链式比较 `a<b<c` 不允许（需括号或逻辑与）。
76. 借用/解引用：`&place` 共享引用、`&mut place` 需可变 place；`*`/`*box` 按引用/Box 规则，其他类型（含 Vec）不可 deref；前缀 `&&x`=`&(&x)`，中缀 `&&` 短路与；访问路径一旦穿过共享引用不能恢复可变访问。
77. 赋值目标须是一个可变 place、类型兼容，否则编译错误；结构体/数组整值可一次赋值；`place=value` 与复合赋值均产生 ()。
78. 求值顺序：一元（标量/共享引用）先操作数后运算；普通二元先左后右；`&&`/`||` 短路；`place=value` 先右值→目标地址→存；复合赋值先右操作数→目标地址→读/更新（官方测试不检查复合赋值两操作数相对顺序）。

# 方法查找/数组/字面量补充
79. 方法查找（method-call-expr.html）：接收者类型须已知；候选顺序=接收者类型、解引用引用与 Box（Vec 不解）后每类型后插 `&T`/`&mut T`；同候选多个不同匹配方法=>UB；唯一匹配即选中；无匹配=>编译错误；实参/expected/接收者 mut 不参与匹配；选中后再查 mut 与实参；方法段类型实参=>编译错误；`Type::method(recv,...)` 用普通 coercion 且同名时固有优先。
80. 数组（array-expr.html）：`[elem; len]` 中元素表达式只求值一次，length>1 时元素须 Copy（非仅 Clone）；长度是常量上下文；空数组/长度 0 语法有效但零大小使用=>UB；索引 expected type=usize，独立类型须 usize，never 索引=>UB；数组内建 `.len()` 接收者 `&self` 返回 usize；数组按值整聚合 copy/move、不 decay。
81. 字面量（literal-expr.html）：前导负号是 NegationExpression；`-2147483648i32` 与 `-(2147483648i32)` 允许有符号最小值；类型选定后超范围=>UB。

# UB 边界汇总（undefined-behavior.html）
82. UB 形式（不出现在任何测试，含不可达代码/常量上下文）：字面量超其确定类型范围；整数推断需 expected 穿透二元/一元/借用；Box::new/Vec::new 省略具体类型实参；把函数用作值；结构体名为 u32/isize/usize/bool/Box/Vec/Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq；局部绑定名为 get_i32/print_i32/println_i32；不可达代码中的 place mutability 违规；数组/Vec 索引为 never；文档注释；let/参数与可见非限定常量同名；不同源类型相等；LUB 无公共目标；点调用多个不同匹配方法；use 违反兼容保证；无效生命周期；可观察零大小数据（`()` 作结果例外）。
83. 零大小数据：仅 `()` 合法作函数/控制流结果；其他需可观察零大小存储的用法 UB（零大小参数/绑定/常量/静态/赋值目标、空结构体/零大小字段、零长度数组/零大小元素、对零大小值的引用与解引用）；非零 T 的空 Vec 合法。
84. 跨类型相等：`==`/`!=` 两侧源类型不同 UB，含共享 vs 可变引用、不同数组类型、不同容器元素类型、Vec vs 数组；仅生命周期不同不区分。
85. 其他保证：use 声明按 Rust 兼容保证有效、不得引入可用新名；生命周期有效性由测试保证、编译器可丢弃生命周期语法且不需借用检查器；未明确分类的普通名称/类型/place-mutability 错误仍是编译错误（含不可达代码）。
</task_result>
</task>

input.prompt:
这是一个纯研究任务，不要写任何代码或文件，也不要修改系统。请通过 webfetch 查阅 ANTLR4 官方仓库的 C++ runtime 文档（例如 https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/blob/master/runtime/Cpp/README.md 的 raw 版本 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antlr/antlr4/master/runtime/Cpp/README.md ），回答在 Ubuntu 24.04 上用 4.13.1 版本构建并链接 ANTLR C++ runtime 的推荐做法。

需要返回：
1. 从源码构建 ANTLR C++ runtime 4.13.1 的准确命令（git clone 指定 tag、cmake 选项、make、安装或本地引用方式），说明如何避免构建 runtime 自带测试。
2. 在 CMake 项目中链接本机编译的 runtime 的推荐方式（include 目录、静态/动态库路径、是否提供 ANTLR4::antlr4 之类的 target、需要链接哪些库如 pthread/dl/uuid）。
3. 使用 antlr 工具为 C++ 目标生成 lexer+parser 的命令（-Dlanguage=Cpp、-visitor/-listener、-o、-lib 的用法），特别是当 Parser.g4 通过 tokenVocab 引用 Lexer.g4 时两个文件应如何一起生成。
4. 生成的 C++ 代码在编译时常需要的宏/选项（如 ANTLR4CPP_STATIC、C++17 标准等）。
5. 存在的版本兼容注意事项：工具版本与 runtime 版本是否必须一致（4.13.1 工具生成代码能否配 4.13.1 runtime）。
6. 是否 apt 仓库有可用的 libantlr4-runtime-dev 版本（Ubuntu 24.04），版本号是多少，是否值得用。

请给出精确、可直接执行的命令和 CMake 片段，标注来源 URL。不要寒暄，控制在 100 行以内。

state.output:
<task id="ses_f130ed345ffenIC64ebBcUzY7I" state="completed">
<task_result>
## 1. 从源码构建 runtime 4.13.1（Ubuntu 24.04）

```bash
git clone --branch 4.13.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/antlr/antlr4.git
cd antlr4/runtime/Cpp
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DANTLR_BUILD_CPP_TESTS=OFF \   # 不拉取 googletest、不编测试
  -DWITH_DEMO=OFF \               # 不需要 Java/antlr jar
  -DANTLR_BUILD_STATIC=ON -DANTLR_BUILD_SHARED=OFF \
  -DANTLR4_INSTALL=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$HOME/antlr4-4.13.1"
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
cmake --install build
```

- `ANTLR_BUILD_CPP_TESTS` 定义在 `runtime/Cpp/runtime/CMakeLists.txt`（默认 ON，会用 FetchContent 下载 googletest）。
- 不想安装时可直接 `add_subdirectory(.../runtime/Cpp ...)` 复用 `antlr4_static` target；或手工引用 `$HOME/antlr4-4.13.1/include/antlr4-runtime` + `lib/libantlr4-runtime.a`。
- 要求 C++17、CMake ≥ 3.15。
  来源：README、`runtime/Cpp/CMakeLists.txt`、`runtime/Cpp/runtime/CMakeLists.txt`。

## 2. CMake 链接（无 `ANTLR4::antlr4` 这个 target）

导出的是 `antlr4_shared` / `antlr4_static` 两个 imported target，并设置 `ANTLR4_INCLUDE_DIR`、`ANTLR4_LIB_DIR`。
来源：`runtime/Cpp/cmake/Antlr4Package.md`

```cmake
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{HOME}/antlr4-4.13.1")
find_package(antlr4-runtime 4.13.1 REQUIRED)      # 包名注意用连字符
add_executable(app main.cpp ${GENERATED_SRCS})
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE antlr4_static)  # 或 antlr4_shared
```

- target 自带 include 目录，代码里 `#include "antlr4-runtime.h"`。
- `antlr4_static`/`antlr4_shared` 以 PUBLIC 方式链接 `Threads::Threads`（即 pthread，见 `runtime/CMakeLists.txt`，对应 issue #3708）；Linux 上不需要显式 dl/uuid。
- 非 CMake 手工方式：`-I$HOME/antlr4-4.13.1/include/antlr4-runtime -L... -lantlr4-runtime -pthread`。

## 3. 生成 lexer+parser（Cpp）

```bash
# 推荐：一次调用，两个文件一起处理，tokenVocab=Lexer 可直接解析
java -jar antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar -Dlanguage=Cpp -visitor -o generated -lib . Lexer.g4 Parser.g4
```

- `-listener` 是默认；`-no-listener` 关闭，`-no-visitor` 默认关 visitor。
- `-o`：输出目录；`-lib`：查找 `.tokens` 与 `import` 文法的目录。来源：`doc/tool-options.md`。
- Parser.g4 若 `options {tokenVocab=Lexer;}`，分两次执行时必须先 lexer 再 parser，并把 tokens 目录给 `-lib`：

```bash
java -jar antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar -Dlanguage=Cpp -o generated Lexer.g4
java -jar antlr-4.13.1-complete.jar -Dlanguage=Cpp -visitor -o generated -lib generated Parser.g4
```

- 生成 `Lexer.{h,cpp}`、`Parser.{h,cpp}`、`ParserBaseListener/Listener/Visitor.{h,cpp}`；编译时把生成的 `.cpp` 全部加入 target。

## 4. 编译宏/选项

- 必须 C++17（README：runtime 最低 C++17；生成的代码同样需要）。
- `ANTLR4CPP_STATIC` 只在 `_WIN32` 下生效（`runtime/src/antlr4-common.h`）；Linux 静态/动态链接都不需要。
- `ANTLR4CPP_EXPORTS` 由 runtime 的 CMake 在 Windows 共享库上自动定义，使用者不用管。
- 若链接静态 runtime 并手工写 flags，记得 `-pthread`。

## 5. 版本兼容

- 工具与 runtime 应完全相同；退一步至少 major.minor 相同。`RuntimeMetaData::checkVersion` 比较 major.minor，不一致时向 stderr 打印 "ANTLR Tool version ... does not match ..."（`runtime/src/RuntimeMetaData.cpp`），不抛异常，但 ATN 序列化/API 仍可能不兼容。
- 4.13.1 工具 + 4.13.1 runtime：官方匹配，推荐；4.13.x 补丁版之间一般可混用。

## 6. Ubuntu 24.04 apt

- `libantlr4-runtime-dev` = **4.10+dfsg-1**（noble/universe，另有 `libantlr4-runtime`、`antlr4` 工具包）。来源：https://people.canonical.com/~ubuntu-archive/madison.cgi?package=libantlr4-runtime-dev
- 只有 4.10，和 4.13.1 工具生成代码不匹配，不建议；除非整条链都用 4.10。需要 4.13.1 就按第 1 节源码构建。

来源 URL：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antlr/antlr4/4.13.1/runtime/Cpp/README.md`、`.../runtime/Cpp/CMakeLists.txt`、`.../runtime/Cpp/runtime/CMakeLists.txt`、`.../runtime/Cpp/cmake/Antlr4Package.md`、`.../runtime/src/RuntimeMetaData.cpp`、`.../runtime/src/antlr4-common.h`、`.../doc/tool-options.md`、`.../doc/options.md`。
</task_result>
</task>

- [ ] 整数类型确定：①后缀；②无后缀取 expected type（仅四种整数之一）；③否则 `i32`。选定后不改；字面量大小不参与类型选择；超范围 = UB

- [ ] 只识别 `Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq`，`#[derive(...)]` 语法解析后做"能力"递归校验：

+    ${GEN_DIR}/Parser.cpp

+    ${GEN_DIR}/ParserListener.cpp

+## 5. 第二步：设计并构建 AST
+
+### 5.1 AST 是什么（用你的解释器类比）
+
+你的 Python 解释器其实是"parse tree 直接求值"。现在中间加一层：
+
+```
+parse tree（ANTLR 给的，深、杂）  ──AstBuilder──▶  AST（你自己定义的，干净、语义化）
+```
+
+AST 节点只保留"程序的含义"，比如：
+
+```rust
+a + b * 2
+```
+
+parse tree 里可能是 `expression → assignmentExpression → ... → additiveExpression(multiplicativeExpression, additiveOperator, multiplicativeExpression)`。
+AST 里就是：
+
+```
+Binary(+, Path(a), Binary(*, Path(b), Literal(2, i32)))
+```
+
+后面类型检查只对着 AST 写，不用再理 ANTLR 的上下文对象。
+
+### 5.2 AST 节点清单（按 Rx 子集）
+
+建议用类继承 + `std::unique_ptr` 管理子节点。带源码位置（`line:col`），报错要用。
+
+**类型（TypeRef）**：
+- `BuiltinType`：`i32 / u32 / isize / usize / bool`（记住四种整数是不同类型！）
+- `StructType(name)`
+- `BoxType(elem)`、`VecType(elem)`
+- `RefType(elem, isMut)`（`&T` / `&mut T`；`&&T` 语法上是两层 `&`）
+- `ArrayType(elem, lengthConstValue)`（`[T; N]`，N 是常量）
+- `UnitType`（`()`）
+
+**顶层项（Item）**：
+- `UseItem`：解析完直接丢掉（不用放进 AST）
+- `FnItem`：名字、参数列表（名字、类型、是否 `mut`）、返回类型（缺省 `()`）、函数体 `Block`
+- `StructItem`：名字、字段列表、derive 列表（`Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq`）
+- `ConstItem`：名字、类型、常量值
+- `ImplItem`：目标类型、关联函数/常量列表（`Self` 在这里可解析）
+
+**语句（Stmt）**：
+- `LetStmt`：模式只有简单名字（可有 `mut`）、可选类型标注、初始化表达式
+- `ExprStmt`：表达式后跟分号
+- 注意块有"尾表达式"：`{ ...; last }` 中 `last` 是这个块的值
+
+**表达式（Expr）**：
+- `LiteralExpr`（值 + 确定的类型 + 原始文本，比如 `0b1010u32`）
+- `PathExpr`（变量、常量、`Type::NAME`、`Self::NAME`）
+- `UnaryExpr`（`- ! * & &mut`）
+- `BinaryExpr`（`+ - * / % & | ^ << >> == != < <= > >= && ||`）
+- `AssignExpr`、`CompoundAssignExpr`
+- `CallExpr`（函数调用、`Box::<i32>::new(..)`、`Vec::<i32>::new(..)`）
+- `MethodCallExpr`（`recv.name(args)`；注意 `.field` 和 `.method(args)` 区分）
+- `FieldExpr`、`IndexExpr`
+- `ArrayExpr`（`[a, b, c]`）与 `RepeatArrayExpr`（`[value; N]`）
+- `StructExpr`（`S { x: 1 }`、`Self { .. }`）
+- `CastExpr`（`as`）
+- `BlockExpr`、`IfExpr`、`LoopExpr`、`WhileExpr`、`BreakExpr`（可带值）、`ContinueExpr`、`ReturnExpr`（可带值）
+- `ParenExpr`（可保留可消除，保留更简单）
+
+### 5.3 AstBuilder 怎么写（两个建议，选一个）
+
+**方案 A（推荐，简单）**：不用 ANTLR 的 `ParserBaseVisitor`，自己写一组递归函数，每个函数处理一种 `Context`，直接返回你想要的类型。因为不同节点返回类型不同，这样比 `std::any` 到处 `any_cast` 更安全、更好调试。
+
+```cpp
+std::unique_ptr<Expr> buildExpr(Parser::ExpressionContext* ctx);
+std::unique_ptr<Expr> buildAdditive(Parser::AdditiveExpressionContext* ctx) {
+    // additiveExpression : multiplicativeExpression (additiveOperator multiplicativeExpression)*
+    auto ops = ctx->additiveOperator();              // 操作符列表
+    auto parts = ctx->multiplicativeExpression();    // 操作数列表
+    auto left = buildMultiplicative(parts[0]);
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < ops.size(); ++i) {        // 左结合，逐个折叠
+        auto right = buildMultiplicative(parts[i + 1]);
+        left = makeBinary(/*op=*/ops[i], std::move(left), std::move(right));
+    }
+    return left;
+}
+```
+
+**方案 B（沿用你熟悉的方式）**：继承 `ParserBaseVisitor`，`visitXxx` 返回 `std::any`，里面装 `std::unique_ptr<Expr>` 等，取出时 `std::any_cast`。可行，但节点类型一多容易写错，而且要小心 `std::unique_ptr` 不能拷进 `std::any`（用 `std::move` 或装裸指针）。
+
+两个方案的共同点：
+- 每个表达式规则大多写成"左结合折叠"：`left (op right)*`（`additiveExpression`、`bitOrExpression`、`logicalAndExpression`……）。
+- `assignmentExpression` 是右结合：`lhs (op rhs)?` 只有一层，直接处理。
+- Parser 里同一表达式有三套规则：普通 `xxxExpression`、条件里的 `conditionXxxExpression`、语句开头的 `statementXxxExpression`。它们结构相同，只是语法消歧用的；**AST 层完全共用同一个节点类型**，写一个公共函数处理即可（否则你要写三遍）。
+- 运算符辅助规则 `shiftRight` (`GT GT_SECOND`)、`comparisonExceptLt`、`assignmentOperator`、`equalsSign` 只是把 token 组合起来，你在 builder 里把它们翻译成一个 `Op` 枚举即可。
+- `>>`、`>=`、`>>=` 这些在文法里被拆成 `GT` + `GT_SECOND` + `SHR_EQ` 等 token（lexer mode 的功劳），Parser 已经处理好了——你按 `ctx` 里实际出现的运算符规则翻译就行，不用自己再做 token 拼接。
+
+### 5.4 本步完成标准
+
+- [ ] `--dump-ast` 能对一段综合代码打印出干净、可读的 AST
+- [ ] `use` 声明和所有 lifetime 语法不进入 AST（`&'a mut T` 只保留 `RefType(mut)`）
+- [ ] 语法正确但没见过的组合不崩溃（哪怕 AST 没建全，也别段错误）
+
